operator: chatbrat.ai (founder: Garret E. Williams, the author of this dataset)
memory_mechanism: Signed-in users: important details are saved as facts per character and retrieved across that character's chats; chat summaries; per-chat relationship state. Guests: no saved facts.
memory_controls: Saved facts can be viewed in the Memory panel and removed with 'Forget this'. Saved facts cannot be edited (forget the fact and restate it). Chat transcripts can be exported; accounts can be deleted.
free_tier: Yes. Free during beta, all features including the BratMind 2.0 model (operator statement, Oct 15, 2026); no card required and payments are not live (pricing page).
paid_price_usd: Nothing is charged during beta. The pricing page lists preview prices for after beta: Basic $4.99/month, Pro $12.99/month, Premium $23.99/month.
age_check_method: Age-confirmation button at entry (operator statement). The terms also describe behavioral risk signals and third-party age assurance in certain jurisdictions.
platforms_app_store_status: Web app today; iOS App Store launch planned for early 2027 (operator statement, Oct 2026; not independently verified).
content_policy: SFW by design: 18+ creative fiction at a 'suggestive ceiling'; explicit sexual content is not permitted.
composable_scenario_storyarc_world: Yes: characters, scenarios, story arcs and worlds are created as separate modules; Compose combines a character with saved scenarios, story arcs and worlds, and each combination starts a new chat (Create page; operator statement).
notable_feature: Compose: users create their own scenarios, story arcs and worlds and combine them with a character, mix-and-match style; each combination starts a new chat. Persistent per-character saved facts.
